title: Chough doctor finds and fixes the Chough debt that stops a fresh worktree from entering Chough (DRIVE-17)
description: chough doctor finds and fixes the Chough debt that stops a fresh worktree from entering Chough (DRIVE-17)
acceptance_criteria: DRIVE-17 (Leif, relayed by orc 2026-11-06, 'Capture + both defaults'), in the new REQ-cli-055 and REQ-history-012. chough doctor reports legacy_checkpoint, stale_pointer, finished_session, stale_gates and unfinished_session findings without a native read. No flag and --dry-run report only and change nothing. --fix applies the safe fixes: adopt the legacy checkpoint, remove a stale pointer, archive finished sessions byte for byte (a session with unfolded inbox entries is skipped). Decision fixes (withdraw stale gates, close sessions named by --close) need --reason; without it they are skipped. No human decision is ever recorded. Exit 0 only when nothing is left. The five new tests in tests/doctor.rs fail first; docs, the skill reference and CHANGELOG say so; fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux.

answers.constraints: DRIVE-17 (new); DRIVE-16 finished rule and session close (#166); DRIVE-13 and DRIVE-3; REQ-history-006 kept-open rule for unfolded inbox entries; --clear-awaiting-human records no human decision; no native read; never replace a file; spec-sync #941 as the debt it replaces by hand.
